voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: For almost twenty years, beginning in nineteen seventy-six, someone in Circleville, Ohio, sent anonymous letters to dozens of residents.
Handwritten. Specific. The writer knew what people had done. And what they had not.
In nineteen seventy-seven, a small handgun was rigged to a mailbox. It was meant for Mary Gilligan.
beats.cap:
A TRAP
RIGGED TO A MAILBOX

beats.vo: Her brother-in-law was convicted. He maintained his innocence. The letters continued while he was in prison.
He served ten years. The case was never solved.
